decision: Exclude 2.785% CarMax transaction ratio and 4.613pp raw gap from companywide peer benchmark and valuation calibration.
interpretation: Majority CAF economics are retained loans funded by secured borrowings, earning spread over time. No observed majority-loan gain-on-sale benchmark.
